overview_description.description:
Prospera Technologies develop computer vision technologies that continuously monitor and analyze plant health, development and stress.
Their technology captures climate and visual data from the ﬁeld and provides actionable insights to growers via mobile and web.

Their team is built of computer scientists, physicists and agronomists combined with experienced agri-business leaders that together, are revolutionizing the tools with which they grow their foods.

about_short_description.short_description: Prospera is an agriculture technology data company that develops intelligent solutions.

product.name: Irrigation Insights
product.description: Provides alerts about pivot-related issues like clogged nozzles and leaks, helping farmers detect and address irrigation problems quickly.

product.name: Irrigation Control
product.description: Allows farmers to monitor and control irrigation pivots and pumps remotely via a mobile app or desktop, reducing the need for field visits.

product.name: Irrigation Planning
product.description: Offers recommendations on when, where, and how much to irrigate based on crop type, soil moisture, and weather data.

product.name: Plant Insights
product.description: Transforms irrigation pivots into crop health monitoring tools, capturing leaf-level images to detect issues like weeds, pests, diseases, and nutrient deficiencies.
